# bufo_bufo (List Resource)

Lists all available bufos.

## Example Usage

```terraform
list "bufo_bufo" "test" {
  provider = bufo

  include_resource = true

  config {
    directory = "bufos"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `directory` (String) The directory name to retrieve bufos from, currently only 'bufos' is accepted.
